# canary reporting costs --month 2026-08 · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
Execution costs  2026-08
  mode paper · base - · no fills retained
  Half-spread paid = (fill − mid) × side × quantity × multiplier at the quote
  retained for the fill; positive is cost, negative is price improvement. Base
  amounts use each fill's own FX rate.

  visibility own_orders_unproven
  No fills from TWS or other API clients have been observed for this account and
  API client. To include them, check that TWS Global Configuration → API →
  Settings → Master API client ID is Canary's client id (7); the owner decides
  that setting.
